scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm calling to check on the status of my loan application. I applied for a home purchase loan, and I'm eager to know if there's been any update. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Yes, I can help with that. Your loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me if my application was approved or denied? And if it was approved, what is my interest rate and the total costs of the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application was approved. The interest rate is 7.5%, and the total costs associated with the loan are $4,559.62.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Can you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for clarifying that. Lastly, can you tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been purchased by Ginnie Mae. The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help. <Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the information provided, and I understand the status of my loan.
